scope: Isolated synthetic PGlite cold-copy backup and independent restore; not a hosted PostgreSQL/PITR or operational demo backup

indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX audit_entity_history ON public.audit_events USING btree (organization_id, entity_type, entity_id, happened_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_events_pkey ON public.audit_events USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX duty_sessions_organization_id_id_key ON public.duty_sessions USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX duty_sessions_pkey ON public.duty_sessions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX followups_due ON public.followups USING btree (organization_id, status, due_date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX followups_pkey ON public.followups USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idempotency_pkey ON public.idempotency USING btree (actor_id, key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX import_batches_organization_id_id_key ON public.import_batches USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX import_batches_pkey ON public.import_batches USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX login_attempts_pkey ON public.login_attempts USING btree (key_hash)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memberships_pkey ON public.memberships USING btree (organization_id, user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memberships_user_id_key ON public.memberships USING btree (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_duty ON public.duty_sessions USING btree (organization_id, executive_id) WHERE (ended_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_rest ON public.rest_intervals USING btree (session_id) WHERE (ended_at IS NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_open_visit_per_executive ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, visitor_id) WHERE (lifecycle = 'open'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX organizations_pkey ON public.organizations USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rest_intervals_pkey ON public.rest_intervals USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_migrations_pkey ON public.schema_migrations USING btree (name)
CREATE INDEX sessions_expiry ON public.sessions USING btree (expires_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sessions_pkey ON public.sessions USING btree (token_hash)
CREATE INDEX shops_assignment ON public.shops USING btree (organization_id, assigned_executive_id)
CREATE INDEX shops_org_name ON public.shops USING btree (organization_id, lower(name))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shops_organization_id_id_key ON public.shops USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shops_pkey ON public.shops USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key ON public.users USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX visits_history ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, shop_id, checked_in_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX visits_open_shop ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, shop_id) WHERE (lifecycle = 'open'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX visits_organization_id_id_key ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX visits_organization_id_id_shop_id_key ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, id, shop_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX visits_pkey ON public.visits USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX visits_reporting ON public.visits USING btree (organization_id, checked_in_at DESC)
